newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise at active auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise at active auction.

text.p: Overseas interest and increased demand from local blenders pushed most grades of Bangladeshi teas up at Tuesday's weekly auction, brokers said.
The market was active, with buyers for Pakistan, Afghanistan, Poland and Russia lifting clean liquoring small brokens and fannings teas.
Some 825,849 kg of tea was sold at an average price of 46.15 taka per kg, 0.52 taka up from previous sale.
The next auction will be held on December 3 with an expected offer of 1.12 million kg.
